digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate documentation and packaged guides
propositions: Author-facing documentation must explain that risky runtime mechanisms whose correctness resolves only after slow codified delivery loops must be de-risked via fast out-of-loop proof before committing to the loop.
The packaged plan guide must identify the de-risk guidance as T15 criterion and specify two permitted fast proof forms: local run or manual probe against the real target.
Plan-review guidance must prescribe that throwaway experiments are cleaned up with teardown scoped only to resources created by the experiment.

The criterion-pins manifest must be regenerated to include the T15 pin, and docs/plan-review-gate.md must update the overlay enumeration from T1–T12 to T1–T15 with current criterion count from registry validation.
All guidance must remain stack-agnostic without product-specific instructions for Terraform, Docker, or other tools.
The rebar explain plan command must render the new T15 slow-loop, local-or-manual-proof, and scoped-cleanup guidance through the packaged guide without breaking existing guidance rendering.
